responses.title: QR Workbench — Free QR Code Generator for 14 Formats
description: Free QR codes for URLs, WiFi, vCards, email and more — generated entirely in your browser. Bulk CSV-to-ZIP generation for hundreds at once, one-time payment.

responses.title: About QR Workbench
description: What QR Workbench is, how the QR encoding actually works, and why it runs entirely in your browser.

responses.title: Bulk (Batch) QR Code Generator — CSV to ZIP | QR Workbench
description: Turn a spreadsheet of URLs, SKUs, or contacts into hundreds of correctly named QR codes, entirely in your browser. Free up to 20 codes, one-time payment for more.

responses.title: Bulk vCard QR Code Generator — CSV to Contact Cards | QR Workbench
description: Turn a staff or guest list into hundreds of individual vCard QR codes — name, phone, email and company per row, generated entirely in your browser.

responses.title: Contact | QR Workbench
description: Get in touch with QR Workbench -- support questions, bug reports, partnership or press inquiries. No phone line; one contact form, answered directly.

responses.title: Disclaimer | QR Workbench
description: QR Workbench encodes the data you provide -- it doesn't verify that data, and doesn't guarantee scan reliability at every size or print quality.

responses.title: Email QR Code Generator — Pre-Filled mailto: QR, Free | QR Workbench
description: Build a mailto: QR code that routes replies before they're even sent — different pre-filled subjects for warranty cards, support desks, or RSVP inserts, so responses arrive already sorted. Free, generated in your browser.

responses.title: Facebook QR Code Generator — Link to Your Page, Free | QR Workbench
description: Generate a QR code that sends customers straight to your Facebook Page, Event, or Group — hours, reviews, directions, or an RSVP in one scan. Built for storefront signage and flyers, not follower growth.

responses.title: Google Forms QR Code Generator — Free, No Sign-Up | QR Workbench
description: Turn a Google Forms link into a QR code for event check-in sheets, in-store feedback kiosks, classroom worksheets, restaurant table tents, and open-house sign-ins. Free, runs entirely in your browser.

responses.title: Instagram QR Code Generator — Link to Your Profile, Free | QR Workbench
description: A QR code built for the follow ask: packaging inserts, receipts, and booth signage that turn a glance into a scan and a scan into a follow — profile or post link, your choice.

responses.title: LinkedIn QR Code Generator — Link to Your Profile, Free | QR Workbench
description: A QR code for the handshake-adjacent moment — conference badges, name tags, and email signatures that turn into a real connection after the event, not a name typed from memory.

responses.title: PDF QR Code Generator — Link to a Hosted PDF, Free | QR Workbench
description: Turn a link to a hosted PDF — a menu, product manual, warranty card, spec sheet, or safety data sheet — into a QR code people scan at the point of use. Free, encodes only the link, hosts nothing.

responses.title: Phone Number QR Code Generator — Tap to Call, Free | QR Workbench
description: A one-field QR code that opens the dialer with a number pre-entered — built for vehicle decals, yard signs, and service vans where a full contact card would be one tap too many. No app, no vCard, just a call.

responses.title: Pricing — QR Workbench
description: Free QR code generation, forever. Bulk CSV-to-ZIP production starts at $7 for one batch, or $39 lifetime for unlimited — one-time payment, no subscription.

responses.title: Privacy Policy | QR Workbench
description: How QR Workbench handles data: every generator, individual and bulk, runs entirely in your browser -- nothing you type is sent to a server.

responses.title: QR Code for Business Cards — Free vCard Generator | QR Workbench
description: Put a scan-to-save contact QR on your business card. Free vCard generator with print-size and design guidance, plus bulk generation for a whole team.

responses.title: QR Code Generator for Inventory & Asset Labels | QR Workbench
description: Generate a QR code per SKU, asset or unit from a spreadsheet — named files, print-ready label sheets, and no inventory data uploaded anywhere.

responses.title: QR Code Generator from CSV — Spreadsheet to QR Codes | QR Workbench
description: Everything your CSV needs to become QR codes: required format, common export mistakes, column mapping, and how large a file can actually run.

responses.title: QR Code Label Generator — Printable A4/Letter PDF Sheets | QR Workbench
description: Turn a spreadsheet into a print-ready PDF sheet of QR code labels. Set page size, grid and captions, preview live, generated entirely in your browser.

responses.title: SMS QR Code Generator — Pre-Filled Text Message QR, Free | QR Workbench
description: Build an sms: QR code for opt-in campaigns and reply-based flows — 'text START to join' sign-ups, event RSVPs, curbside pickup codes. Works over plain cellular SMS, no app required on either end.

responses.title: Spotify QR Code Generator — Link to a Track or Playlist, Free | QR Workbench
description: Turn a Spotify track, album, playlist, or podcast link into a scannable QR code — not a Spotify Code, a standard code any camera can scan. Free, generated in your browser.

responses.title: Terms of Service | QR Workbench
description: The terms for using QR Workbench's free QR generators and bulk workspace.

responses.title: URL QR Code Generator — Free, Static, No Expiry | QR Workbench
description: Turn any link into a QR code, free. The URL is encoded directly — no redirect service, no expiry, generated entirely in your browser.

responses.title: vCard QR Code Generator — Digital Business Card, Free | QR Workbench
description: Turn your contact details into a scannable vCard QR code — name, company, phone, email and website, saved straight to a phone's contacts. Free, generated in your browser.

responses.title: WhatsApp QR Code Generator — Click-to-Chat QR, Free | QR Workbench
description: Build a wa.me click-to-chat QR code with a pre-filled message — for restaurant reservations, retail counters, and support in markets where WhatsApp is the primary channel. Requires WhatsApp on the scanning phone; honestly more useful outside the US.

responses.title: WiFi QR Code Generator — Scan to Connect, Free | QR Workbench
description: Generate a WiFi QR code so guests can join your network by scanning — no typing passwords. Free, static, generated in your browser.

responses.title: YouTube QR Code Generator — Link to a Video or Channel, Free | QR Workbench
description: A QR code that answers 'how does this work' at the moment someone's holding the product, standing at the exhibit, or reading the handout — link a specific video or your whole channel.
